oracleCards.oracle:
({R/P} can be paid with either {R} or 2 life.)
Gain control of target creature an opponent controls until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.

oracleCards.name: Aetherize
oracleCards.oracle: Return all attacking creatures to their owner's hand.

oracleCards.name: Aethersnatch
oracleCards.oracle: Gain control of target spell. You may choose new targets for it. (If that spell becomes a permanent, it enters under your control.)

oracleCards.oracle:
Flying

oracleCards.name: Awaken the Sky Tyrant
oracleCards.oracle: When a source an opponent controls deals damage to you, sacrifice this enchantment. If you do, create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.

oracleCards.name: Blatant Thievery

oracleCards.name: Brainstorm

oracleCards.name: Broodbirth Viper
oracleCards.oracle:
Myriad (Whenever this creature attacks, for each opponent other than defending player, you may create a token copy that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control. Exile the tokens at end of combat.)

oracleCards.oracle:
Create a 5/5 blue and red Elemental creature token with flying.
Retrace (You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a land card in addition to paying its other costs.)

At the beginning of your upkeep, return an instant or sorcery card at random from your graveyard to your hand.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this creature gets +4/+0 until end of turn.

oracleCards.oracle:
Multikicker {1} (You may pay an additional {1} any number of times as you cast this spell.)

{1}{U}{R}: Return this creature to its owner's hand.
